title: Resonance of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: At the moment consciousness returned to his body, the Tianji Record Fragment blazed with heat, and a surge of vast Spiritual Energy poured in from the Void. Chen Ji's meridians shook violently—the barrier of Foundation Building peak collapsed under the resonance of destiny's nourishment, and the pressure of Initial Golden Core swept out like a wild tide!

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's final words before vanishing echoed in his ears—Chen Ji, you are the final piece in my thousand-year scheme, and the only hope. The moment that wisp of remnant soul completely perished, the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly turned into flowing light and entered his Brow Center. A never-before experienced message flooded into his mind: Resonance of Destiny, activate.

dialogue.content: What happened to you? Your face looks so terrible—

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, closing his eyes to focus. Mo Xiansheng's legacy was not merely knowledge, but an entirely new method of connection. He could sense that in the unreachable depths of the Demonic Path, a similarly dormant consciousness was waiting—it was the Demonic Commander, his true ally in three years of scheming. Resonance of Destiny, he would attempt this forbidden technique no one had succeeded in for a thousand years.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing, step back three chi. Whatever you see, do not interrupt me.

text.content: He bit the tip of his tongue, using essence blood as the guide and Heavenly Fate Value as the medium, sketching a mysterious rune in the Void. The Tianji Record Fragment appeared at his Brow Center, emanating a ghostly blue glow. At the same time, thousands of miles away in the Demonic military camp, an almost identical rune lit up simultaneously—righteousness and evil, light and darkness, two fates creating a strange intertwining at this moment.

BOOM—! Chen Ji felt a thunderclap explode in his mind. Consciousness fell into an abyss, then rode clouds and soared, momentarily crossing the barrier between righteousness and evil, encountering another will in a chaotic sea of consciousness. That will was cold and powerful, carrying the Demonic Path's unique gloom, yet hiding unfathomable wisdom. The two silently faced each other, without words, all unresolved mysteries of three years suddenly becoming clear at this moment.

dialogue.content: This... this is Resonance of Destiny?! Impossible! The forbidden technique that even Nascent Soul stage experts never succeeded in, and you, merely at Foundation Building...

text.content: In the Mental Sea, Chen Ji sensed the other party's probe and scrutiny. He did not retreat, but instead proactively opened a segment of memories—that was a glimpse of the future shown by the Tianji Record Fragment: the true face of the Heavenly Eye, the heroic scene of righteous and Demonic paths united in resistance, and... a prophetic image only he could understand. The Demonic Commander's consciousness shuddered violently, and beneath the icy shell, waves arose.

choice.prompt: Resonance of Destiny has been established, Chen Ji needs to decide what information to transmit to the Demonic Commander

choices.description: Fully transmit the Heavenly Eye conspiracy revealed by the Tianji Record to the Demonic Commander, establishing complete trust
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Commander's complete trust, unlock deep intelligence sharing
choices.risk_hint: Massive consumption of Heavenly Fate Value, future foresight ability will be greatly weakened

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, transmitting everything recorded by the Tianji Record Fragment without reservation—the Heavenly Eye's origin, the true origins of righteous and Demonic paths, and the impending catastrophic disaster. The Demonic Commander's consciousness fluctuated violently, and the millennium of icy indifference cracked at this moment.

After a long time, that consciousness transmitted an意念波动: "So it was. A thousand years of chess, merely the Heavenly Dao's game. You and I are both pieces." Chen Ji sensed the Commander's resolve—from this moment, the most secretive cooperation between righteous and Demonic paths was officially forged.

choices.description: Only reveal the Heavenly Eye's existence and ultimate threat, preserving more trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Establish cooperation but retain strategic advantage, maintaining initiative
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Commander may sense the reservation, not opening up completely

text.content: Chen Ji weighed his options for a moment, only transmitting the Heavenly Eye's existence and ultimate threat to the other party. That consciousness fell silent for a long while, seemingly scrutinizing every gap in his words. "You've kept a trump card." A hint of amusement came from the Demonic Commander's consciousness, "But it doesn't matter, this one has kept one too." The two old foxes exchanged a knowing smile in the depths of consciousness.

choices.description: First receive the information from the Demonic Path commander-in-chief, then decide how much to share
choices.visible_reward: Make a decision after obtaining complete intelligence on the Demonic Path commander-in-chief
choices.risk_hint: May appear insincere, affecting the depth of cooperation

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to display anything. Instead, he released a questioning intent. The Demonic Path commander-in-chief's consciousness paused slightly, seemingly surprised by his caution, yet also appreciative. A moment later, vast information flooded in like a tide—the complete contents of the secret orthodox-Demonic agreement, the power structure within the Holy Sect, and... a name that made Chen Ji's body jolt: Chen Nian, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key.

Chen Nian—this name pierced Chen Ji's heart like a blade. His sister, the girl who had been missing for years, had actually been imprisoned by the Holy Sect as a secret weapon to suppress the Tianji Record. No wonder the Tianji Record's visions involving her were always blurry—it wasn't a flaw, but deliberate shielding! A complex emotion came through in the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's consciousness, seemingly regret, or perhaps the empathy of fellow chess pieces.

dialogue.content: You... your expression changed. What did you find?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer her question; the exchange with the Demonic Path commander-in-chief in his consciousness continued. The two strategists at the peak of their respective camps reached a stunning tacit understanding at this moment: on the surface, they were mortal enemies of orthodoxy and evil, but secretly they were comrades-in-arms fighting against the Heavenly Dao. This agreement would remain in effect until the Eye of Heavenly Dao was completely destroyed. And until then, Ye Qing would become the most crucial witness to this hidden bond.

The moment his consciousness returned to his body, Chen Ji's eyes snapped open. Ye Qing's face came into view; her eyes held too many questions, yet she chose silence. Chen Ji looked at her and suddenly showed a faint smile—this woman, who had stayed by his side when he was at his weakest, had not taken the opportunity to pry, but had chosen trust. This ally, he had not misjudged.

dialogue.content: Stop staring! I just... I just didn't want you dying here and wasting my time.

text.content: Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burned scorching hot. A torrent of spiritual energy poured in from the Void, flooding into Chen Ji's body like a dyke bursting. The barrier of Foundation Building peak collapsed under the impact of this force—he was about to break through! From Foundation Building to Golden Core, this was an abyss countless cultivators could never cross in their entire lives, yet Chen Ji, fed back by fate resonance, was about to ascend to heaven in one step!

choice.prompt: With breakthrough imminent, how should Chen Ji guide this power?

choices.description: Completely open the meridians, absorbing all spiritual energy to strike at the Golden Core
choices.visible_reward: Break through steadily to early Golden Core stage with a solid foundation
choices.risk_hint: The process is too fast, possibly triggering celestial phenomena

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, spiritual energy from all directions flowing into his meridians like a hundred rivers returning to the sea. The Golden Core prototype slowly coalesced in his dantian, emanating a soft yet powerful light. As heavenly and earthly spiritual energy churned, cultivators within a hundred li all felt this astonishing breakthrough omen—someone at Tianqing Sect was breaking through to Golden Core!

choices.description: Deliberately slow the breakthrough, hiding part of his strength to play the pig and eat the tiger
choices.visible_reward: Appearing to still be at Foundation Building peak on the surface, actually already at early Golden Core stage
choices.risk_hint: Unstable foundation may affect future ceiling

text.content: Chen Ji frowned slightly, deliberately suppressing the absorption speed of spiritual energy. He didn't want to be too earth-shattering—a废物 servant suddenly becoming a Golden Core stage cultivator would blow up the entire Tianqing Sect. The spiritual energy circulated nine times through his meridians before finally coalescing into a slightly dim Golden Core. Strong appearance but weak inside—this was exactly the effect he needed.

choices.text: Guide spiritual energy to temper the body
choices.description: Utilize excess Spiritual Energy to strengthen the body, forging the strongest foundation
choices.visible_reward: Golden Core quality significantly enhanced, physical body strength doubled
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may have detected the anomaly

text.content: Chen Ji guided half of his Spiritual Energy into his limbs and bones, not to breakthrough the realm, but to temper his physical body. The Golden Core's radiance became restrained, yet more pure and condensed. When the last wisp of Spiritual Energy merged into the Golden Core, he felt an unprecedented fullness - this was not merely a Golden Core, but an indestructible fortress.

However, just at this moment, a sharp sword intent came piercing through the air from afar. Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes - that sword intent was all too familiar to him - Han Lie! That Xuanwu Sect's number one genius with a simple mind but逆天 combat power, actually came looking for him at this moment. It seems the Spiritual Energy fluctuation caused by the fate resonance has alarmed the entire righteous alliance. What a persistent nuisance.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! It's you again! Every time there's a disturbance, you're involved! Today I want to see exactly what tricks this废物 is up to!

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, gazing at the figure descending from the sky, a playful arc curving at the corner of his lips. The old him might have needed to expend considerable effort in maneuvering, but at this moment... the pressure of Golden Core early stage was released like a tide, though most of it was suppressed, wisps still leaked out. Han Lie's expression abruptly changed, his steps faltering as he nearly tumbled from the sky.
A废物 at Foundation Building peak? Han Lie, are those eyes of yours just for show?

Han Lie's face turned ashen - the pressure of Golden Core stage was unmistakable. That servant废物 everyone in the righteousness had ridiculed, actually broke through to Golden Core before everyone's eyes! His fists clenched until they creaked, humiliation and rage almost devouring him - how many times now? Every time he thought victory was certain, this废物 would ruthlessly slap his face! Ye Qing watched this scene, a flash of satisfaction flickering in her eyes. Chen Ji's counterattack had always been so pleasing to witness.

choice.prompt: Faced with Han Lie's intimidation, how does Chen Ji choose to end this?

choices.description: Humiliate Han Lie with absolute strength publicly, thoroughly shattering his arrogance
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie's reputation greatly diminished, Chen Ji's reputation greatly increased
choices.risk_hint: May attract attention from Xuanwu Sect higher-ups

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely raised one finger and gently pushed forward. No fancy techniques, only pure realm suppression. The Golden Core pressure transformed into an invisible giant hand, slamming Han Lie hard into the ground. Han Lie didn't even have time to react before his entire body tumbled down like a disconnected kite, creating a massive crater upon impact.

Lying at the bottom of the pit, Han Lie spat blood, his eyes filled with disbelief. The righteous disciples who had rushed over stood in dead silence, their gazes toward Chen Ji carrying fear for the first time. This废物 servant, just how many hidden cards did he still have?

choices.description: Withdraw the pressure, display a magnanimous attitude, further consolidate the tiger-eating-pig persona
choices.visible_cost: Unable to completely defeat Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: Righteous disciples mock Han Lie, increasing his psychological trauma
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may not give up and continue to harass

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his pressure, a faint smile on his face: "Senior Han, why such great anger? Just a fortunate breakthrough, why make such a big fuss?" His tone was mild, even carrying concern, yet it made Han Lie feel a deeper humiliation than before. This was mocking him! Striking his face in front of everyone!

choices.description: Reveal part of the truth to Han Lie, drawing him into the chess game against the Heavenly Secrets
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful enforcer and expand the alliance
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's impulsive nature may cause trouble

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his voice and whispered a few words into Han Lie's ear. No one knew what was said, only that Han Lie's expression shifted from anger to shock, then from shock to deep contemplation. Finally, he snorted coldly and swept away with his sleeves, though the killing intent in his retreating figure had diminished. A curve formed at the corner of Chen Ji's lips—brute strength has its uses too, doesn't it?

After Han Lie left in defeat, Chen Ji turned to Ye Qing, his gaze carrying a hint of scrutiny. He needed to confirm one thing—whether this Demonic Path Saint who had witnessed everything was worth his further trust. The aftermath of the Blood Resonance still left him somewhat weakened, but his eyes remained sharp as blades. This woman had just observed his entire connection with the Demonic Path Commander—if she harbored any intentions...

Ye Qing seemed to see through his concerns and spoke proactively: "You're wondering if I'll report today's events to the Holy Sect?" She laughed lightly, her smile carrying a trace of bitterness. "You think I became the Holy Saint by choice? I'm merely a tool. Allying with you at least gives us a common goal—breaking free from the fate of being used as chess pieces."

Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then nodded. He drew a Jade Slip from his sleeve—the full text of the Orthodox-Demonic secret agreement transmitted by the Demonic Path Commander through Blood Resonance. Now, he chose to share this secret that could overturn the entire cultivation world with Ye Qing. From this moment, their relationship would fundamentally change—no longer simple exploitation, but true allies, fighting together in fate's chess game.

Ye Qing accepted the Jade Slip and probed it with her spiritual sense. A moment later, her eyes reddened slightly—the filth within the Holy Sect was far worse than she had imagined. She thought being used as a tool was already pitiful enough, but she hadn't known that those seemingly dignified elders had long been secretly preparing her as a sacrificial offering. Chen Ji's appearance gave her a chance to escape all this.

dialogue.content: This agreement... I, Ye Qing, swear to the heavens: from this day forward, I shall advance and retreat together with Chen Ji. Until the Heavenly Eye is destroyed, this oath shall not be lifted.

text.content: The moment the oath fell, the aftermath of the Blood Resonance finally dissipated. Chen Ji felt a strange power flowing through his meridians—that was Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist energy, creating a subtle resonance with his Tianji Record. What did this mean? The last message left by Mo Xiansheng flashed through his mind: when Blood Resonance stabilizes, those with karmic bonds to him would share part of the Tianji Record's masking abilities. From now on, his Heavenly Secrets would be far harder for the Heavenly Eye to detect.

This night was destined to be recorded in history. The humblest waste servant disciple of the orthodox path and the most enigmatic saint of the Demonic Path, under witness of fate, forged an unbreakable alliance. Far away, at a certain location, an invisible eye gazed upon all this—the Heavenly Eye, it sensed a new variable appearing on the chessboard, yet still did not understand what this variable truly meant.

The moment consciousness returned to his body, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burned intensely. A majestic Spiritual Energy poured in from the Void, causing Chen Ji's meridians to violently shake—the barrier of Foundation Building Peak shattered under the counteraction of Blood Resonance, and the pressure of the initial Golden Core stage burst forth like a wild tide!
